title: Chapter 295: Team Annihilation
content:
Chapter 295: Team Annihilation

What's more, this was because she blessed her bloodline.

Bingfeng bloodline.

Lu Xue rarely uses it because she has basically never fought much.

But she would not forget that even though she had never used it, Lu Xue's Bingfeng bloodline was still strong.

As Lu Xue walked further and further, the bloodline of Ice and Snow continued to transform like her extreme ice spirit body.

Nowadays, it is like an ancient ferocious beast.

As soon as the ice phoenix appears, all things are gone.

"Give it to me!"

Lu Xue poked out her palm and flipped it down.

Suddenly, the entire ice domain changed again.

"Damn it, the Immortal Lord Realm is so strong. How can I reach the Immortal Emperor Realm?"

In the distance, the woman in the bow and arrow thought she was safe and was about to escape from here and escape from Lu Xue's ice domain.

Thinking of the strength Lu Xue just showed, she felt a thrill.

A monster.

Is this really a person from the world?

Just as she was thinking, her breathing suddenly stopped.

The bone-bone chill actually ignored her fairy energy and poured into her body.

In an instant, her speed suddenly decreased.

"not good!"

The woman's face changed suddenly.

And at this moment, the sound of breaking through the air sounded.

Lu Xue's back had black ice wings, standing proudly in front of her.

"Run, keep running."

At this moment, Lu Xue smiled with a bit of joke.

She really doesn't know how she loses.

"Do you really want to kill them all?"

Looking at Lu Xue who was blocking her body, the woman with bow and arrow gritted her teeth.

At this moment, Lu Xue's smile looked extremely creepy in her eyes, which made her unable to help but feel frightened.

She hasn't seen any storm before.

"Haha, I'm too lazy to reason with you."

"You don't deserve to listen!"

When Lu Xue heard the woman with bow and arrow, she immediately understood that to reason with such a person, that is to play the piano to a cow.

Buzz —

Suddenly, a long sword made of Xuanbing condensed out of thin air in Lu Xue's hand.

Three feet long and two fingers wide, exuding a unique breath of Lu Xue throughout the body.

"cut!"

Lu Xue slashed out with a sudden sword.

The sword light rushed out and gradually evolved into a lifelike ice phoenix in the air, rushing towards the woman with bow and arrow in the distance.

Seeing this, the woman with bow and arrow looked shocked and quickly retreated, pulled the distance and shot it out with an arrow.

call out!

The arrow feathers broke through the air and collided directly with the Ice Phoenix condensed by the sword light.

However, the familiar penetration sound did not sound.

Instead, her arrow feathers were cut off with a click.

"What!"

Puchi!

Blood gushed out, and with just one blow, the woman with bow and arrow was seriously injured.

Generally speaking, she will not let the enemy get close.

Because there will be teammates blocking the enemy, and she outputs quietly in the rear.

But this time it obviously won't work.

Because she came alone.

She can't blame her, Ao Qing is a nine-clawed extreme dragon, and her defense is naturally abnormal. Her arrows cannot cause harm to Ao Qing, so she will have no use to go to Ao Qing.

So she came to Lu Xue alone.

But what she never expected was that Lu Xue, the Immortal Lord Realm, could torture her, the Immortal Emperor Realm.

This is simply unreasonable!

"Save me!"

Looking at Lu Xue who was walking slowly towards her, the woman with bow and arrow eyes were full of fear.

Draw the bow again.

laugh!

Lu Xue slashed out a sword at will, and the large eagle bow in his hand suddenly broke into two pieces.

At this moment, the woman in the bow and arrow was completely stunned.

This is an imperial weapon!

However, Lu Xue's casual sword was cut out with the Xuanyuan Sword.

Regardless of whether you are an emperor or not.

At this time, Lu Xue had already walked to the woman with bow and arrow.

Looking at Lu Xue's cold face, then looking at the distance, there was no movement. She knew that she lost.

Lost all the money.

I'm afraid my teammates are already at a loss for life and death.

They underestimated the Nine-Clawed Dragon and also underestimated Lu Xue.

"We should have thought of it as someone who can convince the Nine-Clawed Dragon."

The woman laughed at herself.

The next moment, a miserable head rolled onto the ground.

"Hmph, you dare to provoke us no matter what kind of garbage."

Lu Xue was in a bad mood and looked around.

"I know that many of you have seen us, but we are not afraid and want to attack us. We can come and wait at any time."

The sound fell without causing any sensation.

Just silent on the outside of the ancient battlefield.

It was not until Lu Xue turned around and left that many auras surged out from the darkness, and these auras were all scrambling to leave.

Too scary.

Is this the real strength of the Master Jiu Clawed Dragon?

"Little Master!"

In the distance, Ao Qing rushed towards Lu Xue.

It can be seen from the naked eye that Ao Qing's body is covered with blood.

Seeing this scene, Lu Xue trembled, "Xiaoqing, you, are you injured?!"

Upon hearing this, Ao Qing was slightly stunned, and then smiled and said, "How could I get hurt against that kind of enemy? It's all their blood."

Hearing this, Lu Xue breathed a sigh of relief.

"All solved?"

"Uh, no."

Lu Xue frowned suddenly, "No?"

Ao Qing lowered his head slightly, feeling guilty, "I ran away, that guy cheated his teammate, and then disappeared in a blink of an eye."

He had no choice, either.

The guy who ran was so scheming.

Direct sacrifice to teammates.

Otherwise, with his strength, it would be better to directly kill the two of them.

After hearing Ao Qing's explanation, Lu Xue felt helpless.

But I was a little worried.

If you run away with a scheming attitude, that's even worse.

If the other party secretly takes revenge, although they are strong, who promises that there will be no failure?

When you walk on the roadside, you can’t help but get your shoes wet.

"Forget it, let's go and see how those two guys are doing."

Lu Xue laughed and said nothing.

Hearing this, Ao Qing said oh and crawled directly on Lu Xue's shoulder.

On the other side, there is a dark and secret cave.

A black-armored man was covered in blood and was leaning against the cave wall and gasping for breath.

His face was sweating even more.

"The nine-clawed dragon is so terrifying. That guy Ah Hong also fell into trouble. Damn it!"

The black-armored man punched the wall with a sudden punch.

The power was so great that the entire cave buzzed.

"Lu Xue, Nine-Clawed Dragon, I've recorded this revenge!"

After gasping for a moment, the black-armored man gritted his teeth, his eyes full of hatred.

Very ridiculous.

They obviously provoked them first, but after being counterattacked, they held a grudge against each other.

Unfortunately, this is how people like him think.

If he could let go of his hatred and leave the ancient battlefield at this moment, perhaps he could really save his life.

It's a pity that there is no if.

"I'm very sorry, you can't avenge this revenge."

A faint voice rang out from the black-armored man without any warning.

In an instant, the man in black armor felt like he fell into an ice cave, and his face was even more terrified.

who?

when?

laugh!

A sword light flashed by.

The black-armored man was stunned.

It was not until the black shadow got up and left that after a long time, the head of the black-armored man slowly fell down.

The incision is smooth like a mirror.

At this point, the group was destroyed.
